channel.title: The Tidewater News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Tidewater News (thetidewaternews.com)

item.title: Early Childhood WT asks Franklin for support
item.description: Early Childhood Western Tidewater’s director asked Franklin City Council to release $19,536 in carryover funds and restore $13,000 in annual aid after the city ended its fiscal role.

item.title: Why More Tidewater Families Are Choosing Pet Adoption and Prioritizing Emergency Care
item.description: Pet adoption is becoming increasingly popular in the Tidewater region, as more families discover the joy of welcoming a furry friend into their homes.

item.title: Council meets with city manager candidates
item.description: Franklin City Council meets behind closed doors with one city manager candidate, plans talks with a second as it moves toward possible selection.

item.title: Dinner delivers ‘Thank you’ to area first responders
item.description: Ninth annual First Responder Dinner in Franklin-Southampton served 280 first responders from 14 agencies, backed by local volunteers and sponsors providing steak meals and fellowship.

item.title: Swann B. Broocke
item.description: Swann Burgess Bradshaw Broocke, 93, passed away Feb. 18, 2026 at The Village at Woods Edge.

item.title: Bailey responds to Citizens Time change delay
item.description: Franklin school board vice chair challenges chair’s claim that a board-approved change to public comment rules was handled incorrectly and only applied for one meeting.

item.title: LETTER: Holt responds to column criticism
item.description: Robert Holt defends his column on Franklin School Board powers, explaining policy-drafting steps and Virginia laws that restrict public discussion of personnel matters.

item.title: COLUMN: When leadership loses its moral compass, students pay the price
item.description: Franklin City School Board member John Allsbrook says Chair Cristina Boone’s lack of transparency and accountability erodes trust, hurts students, and shows the division needs new leadership.

item.title: FCPS leaders clash on whistle-blower policy
item.description: Franklin City School Board voted 7-0 to order a whistle-blower policy, sparking a tense dispute with Superintendent Dr. Carlton Carter over redundancy, workload and trust.

item.title: Franklin, SCPS, IW schools on 2-hour delay on Feb. 23
item.description: Franklin, Southampton and Isle of Wight schools and Isle of Wight Academy will open on a two-hour delay Monday, Feb. 23, as divisions monitor winter weather and road conditions.
